analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY confirmed uptrend (+2.3% vs SMA50, 20d slope +4.93%). Environment supports holding and measured deployment, not aggressive accumulation.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW:
- A ($129.55, -0.12%): Thesis intact. Uptrend basing at 42% of 52w range, SMA50 slope positive. Earnings 75 days out. Hold.
- ADP ($225.77, -1.16%): Thesis intact. 32% of 52w range, strong franchise (71% ROE, 30% op margin), recovering well. Earnings July 29. Hold.
- IQV ($181.06, +0.28%): Thesis intact. 30% of 52w range, basing. Earnings July 21 — watch for volatility. Hold.
No stop-outs or thesis breaks. Portfolio heat is extremely low at 0.98%, and 51% of equity sits in cash. In an uptrend regime, this is justification to deploy into 1-2 additional high-conviction setups.

NEW CANDIDATES: FICO stands out clearly — exceptional operating economics (58% op margin, 38.7% revenue growth, PEG 0.80) at a still-corrected price (26% of 52w range, -17.6% vs SMA200). It is basing in the lower half of its range with a positive SMA50 slope — classic Stage 1→2 transition. LII (Lennox International) offers a second diversified entry: industrials, 76% ROE, above SMA200, basing at 36% of 52w range. Both offer R/R above 2x with properly sized stops. Extended setups (APH 82%, NXPI 80%, TER 89%) are ruled out per entry rules. FDS skipped due to earnings in 19 days. All 5 positions post-trade would remain within concentration limits.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $1185 or better on any intraday pullback; do not chase above $1220
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: FICO is one of the highest-quality businesses in the S&P 500 — 58% operating margin, 38.7% revenue growth, PEG of 0.80, and strong FCF ($731M). The FICO Score franchise is a durable monopoly with pricing power. Forward P/E of 21.8x is reasonable given the growth trajectory. EPS revisions trending up (+1.9%). TECHNICAL: Stock has corrected 38% from its 2025 peak and now sits at 26% of its 52w range, basing with SMA50 slope just turning positive (+1.0%). Price is -17.6% vs SMA200, meaning the SMA200 recovery provides a natural medium-term target around $1436–$1450. Confirmed uptrend (basing) with controlled volatility. Classic asymmetric setup: quality business at a discounted price with trend just inflecting upward.
trades.exit_plan: Stop at $1071 (1.75x ATR below entry). Exit if SMA50 slope turns negative and price breaks below SMA50 on volume. Trim 50% near $1350 if reached quickly (overbought risk). Hold remainder toward $1450 for LTCG consideration if >6 months elapsed. Thesis breaks if operating margin deteriorates materially below 50% or revenue growth decelerates below 20%.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $515–$520; entry at current market acceptable given basing confirmation
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Lennox International is a high-quality industrial compounder — 76.8% ROE, 14.3% op margin, steady FCF. HVAC demand is structurally supported by aging infrastructure and energy-efficiency retrofit tailwinds. Revenue growth 5.8% is modest but consistent; forward P/E of 19.4x is fair for this ROE profile. D/E of 161% is manageable given strong cash generation ($810M op CF). TECHNICAL: LII is at 36% of its 52w range and has already reclaimed SMA200 (+1.5%), distinguishing it from deeper-recovery candidates. SMA50 slope is positive (+1.6%), price +3.1% above SMA50 but not extended. Basing pattern following a -21% correction from 2025 highs. Earnings July 29 (47 days) provide runway for thesis to develop without near-term binary event risk.
trades.exit_plan: Stop at $479.90 (1.75x ATR). Exit or reduce ahead of July 29 earnings if position shows <5% gain (avoid holding through binary event with thin cushion). Full exit if quarterly margin guidance disappoints or residential construction data deteriorates sharply. Hold past 1-year mark if thesis intact for LTCG treatment.
